name: @agentos/migration
description: MigrationVault (Base) + MerkleVestingDistributor (Robinhood) for the CAP + DACKIE -> AGENTOS migration

scripts.deploy:vault:base: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'forge script scripts/DeployVault.s.sol --rpc-url base --account "${DEPLOYER_ACCOUNT:?set DEPLOYER_ACCOUNT in .env}" --broadcast'
scripts.deploy:distributor:robinhood: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'forge script scripts/DeployDistributor.s.sol --rpc-url robinhood --account "${DEPLOYER_ACCOUNT:?set DEPLOYER_ACCOUNT in .env}" --broadcast'
